# Host guidance

This file is the lightweight, general-purpose guidance for this host development environment. Keep it concise and suitable for users to extend with their own tooling notes.

For the repository-level agent entry point (project overview, structure, instruction index), start with [the agent main instructions](../.agents/main.instructions.md).

For Earth application development, architecture, commands, and package boundaries, follow [the development instructions](dev/copilot-instructions.md).
